entities.summary:
Saint Tydfil, a 5th-century Welsh saint, has left an enduring legacy in Merthyr Tydfil, Wales. Dedicated to her memory, the old parish church of St Tydfil in Merthyr Tydfil is reputed to be the site of her death.

As a key figure in Welsh Christian history, Saint Tydfil's life and teachings continue to captivate scholars and locals alike.

Despite limited historical records, her impact on Welsh culture and identity is undeniable.

The city's name, Merthyr Tydfil, is a testament to her enduring presence in the region.

She has been the subject of local folklore and has been revered as a patron saint of the city.

The site of her death, the old parish church of St Tydfil, has become a place of pilgrimage for those seeking spiritual guidance and connection to their heritage.

In an era where faith and identity are increasingly intertwined, Saint Tydfil's story serves as a powerful reminder of the enduring power of spirituality and community.
